## Source request

Closes #

Decision: accepted / accepted with maintainer revisions

## Change type

- [ ] Member profile
- [ ] Publication
- [ ] News
- [ ] Correction or site maintenance

## Maintainer checks

- [ ] The request contains enough public, verifiable information.
- [ ] I reviewed and, where needed, revised the submitted wording.
- [ ] `ruby scripts/validate_content.rb` passes.
- [ ] `bundle exec al-folio upgrade audit` passes without findings.
- [ ] `bundle exec al-folio upgrade overrides audit --fail-on-stale` passes.
- [ ] `bundle exec jekyll build` passes.
- [ ] I visually checked the affected page when presentation changed.
- [ ] No private contact details or unlicensed assets were added.
